title: TaskRecord
description: The hand-off of one agent task as the verifier reads it (ADR-0040): which receipts the task cites. Both receipts are optional here so that the verifier, not the parser, reports a missing one. A JSON file or the YAML front matter of a Markdown file.

pendingWriteBack.description: Outbox ids of memory writes this task made while the Worldbuilder was unreachable and that were not yet offered as card proposals (ADR-0046). They are reported by the verifier and never make a record invalid.

receiptRef.title: ReceiptRef
receiptRef.description: A receipt cited by id and hash.
